title: Rack-Scale Supernode Selection: NVIDIA GB200/GB300 NVL72 (72-GPU NVLink 5 + C2C) vs. 8-GPU HGX H200/B200 Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: 9x 8-GPU HGX H100 Nodes (EP=72 Crossing 50 GB/s Inter-Node RDMA on Every MoE Layer)
tiers.verdict: Baseline: 8-GPU NVLink boundary forces EP=72 All-to-All over 50 GB/s RDMA; PCIe Gen5 caps host KV recall at 64 GB/s

tiers.name: Tier 2: 9x 8-GPU HGX H200 Nodes (141GB HBM3e + DeepEP IBGDA Over 400G RDMA)
tiers.verdict: Best air/45kW-DLC choice when colocation facility cannot support 125kW/rack liquid-cooled NVL72

tiers.name: Tier 3: 9x 8-GPU HGX B200 x86 Nodes (NVFP4 + 8-Way NVLink 5, Inter-Node 800G RDMA for EP=72)
tiers.verdict: Fast NVFP4 compute, but 8-GPU NVLink ceiling still forces cross-node RDMA for EP>8 and PCIe x86 bottlenecks

tiers.name: Tier 4: Single GB200/GB300 NVL72 Rack (72-GPU 1,800 GB/s NVLink 5 Domain + 450 GB/s/GPU Grace C2C LPDDR5X)
tiers.verdict: Recommended for Giant MoE: EP=72 runs 100% inside 1,800 GB/s NVLink 5! 7,420 tok/s/GPU, 5.2ms TPOT & $0.13/1M
